role: Explicit coding-only simplicity overlay and router for bounded simplification views.
notes: Orthogonal to Ship. Preserve accepted requirements, repository policy, safety, evidence, and authority.

children.note: Route a named read-only review, repository audit, marker ledger, pinned benchmark card, or help request directly; none runs automatically after implementation

pipeline: explicit coding request may use the overlay without a child
named review, audit, debt, gain, or help request routes directly to one child
child returns to the actual caller; no automatic fix, test, Git, publication, or mode change
